Name: Cabin House
Author: giovannim
Description:
I like playing on small farm maps and just don't usually like the look of the normal farmhouse fully upgraded! So I made a quick and dirty patch to make your house into one of the vanilla cabins. Just set which cabin style you want to use in the config.json, (or select it from the generic mod config menu) and this will pretty much patch your farmhouse exterior into a cabin, same footprint (I think) and all.

Some notes and known bugs, I haven't all the way tested things and don't plan to fuss much so...

- Robin will work one tile away from where your cabin actually is when she upgrades it. I have no idea how to fix this, but it still works fine and she won't be there forever.
- Similarly, NPCs show up probably where they would on the main farmhouse, so a little to the right of the cabin. I can't quite figure out how to change that
- For the Qi quest where you check the lumber pile, just check one tile left of your door and you should be able to get the thing.

I think that's all? I mostly made this for me but maybe someone else will get some use from it!
